name: PartyFinder
description: Party Finder: a global public server browser for Machine Party, built on Steam networking.

godot.description_rich:
Party Finder adds a full server browser to Machine Party, built entirely on Steam networking.

- Replaces the main menu JOIN button with a global (not region locked) lobby browser.
- Adds a 'Make Lobby Public' toggle to the host's lobby screen, with a lobby name and a max players stepper (1 to 4).
- Public lobbies are listed worldwide. Private lobbies are still joined by their room ID code.

It does not change how the base game's networking works.
